topics.business: Organizational adoption, economic outcomes, investment and operating models.
topics.cognition: Understanding, cognitive effort, mental models and cognitive load.
topics.context: Unidentified or genuinely general contextual sources without a more specific established topic.
topics.cost: Financial, token, compute and usage costs or cost accounting.
topics.diversity: Diversity of research questions, approaches and knowledge production.
topics.engineering: Software development, maintenance, engineering workflows and developer tools.
topics.governance: Policies, responsibility, attribution, consent and institutional oversight.
topics.judgment: Expert judgment, interpretation and choosing meaningful problems or outcomes.
topics.learning: Education, training, skill formation, retention and learning design.
topics.mathematics: Mathematical research, mathematical learning, theorem proving, proof assistants and mathematical-community perspectives.

topics.productivity: Task performance, throughput, delivery and productivity measurement.

topics.reasoning: Reasoning performance and the interpretation of reasoning capabilities.

policy: Use multiple labels for substantive source focus, not every incidental mention. Classify supporting references only from established metadata; classification does not upgrade evidence verification. Keep unidentified candidates as context. Reviewed corrections override title heuristics.
